abi-dalzims-horrid-wilting.name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting

saveModifiers.reason: Plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage.

effects.description: Each non-Construct, non-Undead creature in the 30-foot Cube centered on a point within 150 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 12d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success; Plants and Water Elementals make this save with Disadvantage.

abi-dalzims-horrid-wilting.description: You draw the moisture from every creature in a 30-foot cube centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and undead aren't affected, and plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage. A creature takes 12d8 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

absorb-elements.name: Absorb Elements

combatCost.condition: when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage

effects.description: The caster gains defensive protection against the triggering elemental damage type until the start of the caster's next turn.
The caster's next melee attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering damage type, increasing by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends after the first melee attack hit on the caster's next turn spends the stored energy.

absorb-elements.description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. Also, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends.
absorb-elements.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

acid-splash.name: Acid Splash

effects.description: Create an acidic burst at a point within 60 feet; creatures in the 5-foot-radius Sphere make a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 Acid damage on a failure, and damage increases to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.

acid-splash.description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.
acid-splash.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

aid.name: Aid

effects.description: Choose up to three creatures within 30 feet for 8 hours; each target increases current and maximum Hit Points by 5, plus 5 more Hit Points per slot level above 2.

hitPointState.scaling: +5 current and maximum Hit Points per spell slot level above 2

aid.description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.
aid.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

alarm.name: Alarm

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs a bell and silver wire; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

effects.description: Create an audible alarm on a door, window, or 20-foot Cube within range; when a creature touches or enters the warded area, the ward emits a handbell sound for 10 seconds within 60 feet.

soundEmission.description: Produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds.

effects.description: Create a mental alarm on a door, window, or 20-foot Cube within range; when a creature touches or enters the warded area, the caster receives a mental ping within 1 mile that can wake them from sleep.

alarm.description: You set an alarm against intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental: Audible Alarm. The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area. Mental Alarm. You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

options.label: Audible Alarm
options.summary: The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area.

options.label: Mental Alarm
options.summary: You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

alter-self.name: Alter Self

effects.description: Aquatic Adaptation lets you breathe underwater and grants a Swim Speed equal to your Speed for the duration.
Change Appearance alters your outward look and voice while keeping the same basic body shape and game statistics; physical inspection can reveal the disguise.

visionLightSound.repeatChange: Magic action can change appearance again during duration
visionLightSound.physicalInspection: can reveal disguise because body remains physically constrained

effects.description: Natural Weapons grow claws, fangs, horns, or hooves that make your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 of the chosen physical damage type using your spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls.

alter-self.description: You alter your physical form. Choose one of the following options. Its effects last for the duration, during which you can take a Magic action to replace the option you chose with a different one. Aquatic Adaptation. You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. Change Appearance. You alter your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. For the duration, you can take a Magic action to change your appearance in this way again. Natural Weapons. You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). When you use your Unarmed Strike to deal damage with that new growth, it deals 1d6 damage of the type in parentheses instead of dealing the normal damage for your Unarmed Strike, and you use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

options.label: Aquatic Adaptation
options.summary: You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

options.label: Change Appearance
options.summary: You alter your appearance. You decide what you look like. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change.

options.label: Natural Weapons
options.summary: You grow natural weapons dealing 1d6 damage, using your spellcasting ability modifier for attack/damage rolls.

animal-friendship.name: Animal Friendship

effects.description: One beast-like target within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed for 24 hours; higher slots add one target per slot level.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends if the caster or one of the caster's allies deals damage to the target.

socialEffect.notes: The beast is Charmed for the duration unless the caster or an ally damages it.

animal-friendship.description: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends.
animal-friendship.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

animal-messenger.name: Animal Messenger

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs a morsel of food; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

saveOutcomeOverrides.reason: auto_success when challenge rating not zero.

effects.description: Choose a visible Tiny Beast within 30 feet to carry a message of up to 25 words to a described recipient at a visited location. The Beast makes a Charisma save to resist, with non-CR-0 Beasts automatically succeeding; on failure it travels about 25 miles per 24 hours, or 50 miles if it can fly, and the message is lost if it does not arrive before the spell ends. Higher slots extend the duration by 48 hours per slot level above 2nd.

endCleanup.result: message is lost and beast returns to where the spell was cast
endCleanup.note: not an early ending, but explicit duration-expiry cleanup for routing systems

communicationDetails.recipientDescription: recipient matching caster general description at a visited location
communicationDetails.delivery: Tiny Beast mimics caster communication when it arrives
communicationDetails.travelRate: about 25 miles per 24 hours or 50 miles if flying
communicationDetails.failure: if destination is not reached before spell ends, message is lost and Beast returns to casting location

travelDetails.failure: if destination is not reached before spell ends, message is lost and Beast returns to casting location

aiContext.prompt: Choose a visible Tiny Beast within range, a visited destination, a recipient described generally enough for the Beast to identify, and a message of up to 25 words. Confirm whether the Beast can fly for travel speed and whether its Challenge Rating is 0 or it automatically succeeds on the saving throw.

animal-messenger.description: A Tiny Beast of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw, or it attempts to deliver a message for you (if the target's Challenge Rating isn't 0, it automatically succeeds). You specify a location you have visited and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a person dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also communicate a message of up to twenty-five words. The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location, covering about 25 miles per 24 hours or 50 miles if the Beast can fly. When the Beast arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, mimicking your communication. If the Beast doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell.
animal-messenger.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell's duration increases by 48 hours for each spell slot level above 2.

animal-shapes.name: Animal Shapes

effects.description: Choose any number of willing visible creatures within 30 feet for up to 24 hours and shape-shift each into a caster-chosen Large-or-smaller Beast form of Challenge Rating 4 or lower, with different forms allowed per target and later Magic-action re-transforms. Targets use Beast statistics but retain creature type, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, alignment, communication, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; cannot cast spells; are limited by Beast anatomy; have equipment merged and unusable; and can end their own transformation with a Bonus Action.

grantedActions.action: Transform the spell targets again into eligible Beast forms.
grantedActions.notes: The granted action is available on later turns while the spell remains active.

controlOptions.name: Beast form
controlOptions.effect: Each willing target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast with Challenge Rating 4 or lower.
controlOptions.details: The caster can choose a different eligible form for each target.

controlOptions.name: Repeat transformation
controlOptions.effect: On later turns, the caster can take a Magic action to transform the targets again.
controlOptions.details: Runtime maxTargets uses the explicit unlimited sentinel because the canonical prose allows any number of willing visible targets in range.

controlOptions.name: Stat replacement
controlOptions.effect: The target uses the chosen Beast statistics but retains creature type, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, alignment, communication, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.
controlOptions.details: The target cannot cast spells and its actions are limited by the Beast form anatomy.

controlOptions.name: Equipment merge
controlOptions.effect: The target equipment melds into the form and cannot be used while transformed.

effects.description: Each target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which it shape-shifts. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends.

animal-shapes.description: Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. You can choose a different form for each target. On later turns, you can take a Magic action to transform the targets again. A target's game statistics are replaced by the chosen Beast's statistics, but the target retains its creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; alignment; ability to communicate; and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target's actions are limited by the Beast form's anatomy, and it can't cast spells. The target's equipment melds into the new form, and the target can't use any of that equipment while in that form. The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the first form into which it shape-shifts. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends. The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target ends it as a Bonus Action.

animate-dead.name: Animate Dead

components.materialDescription: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust

instanceAllocation.notes: Reassert-control mode can affect up to four existing undead animated with this spell, plus two more undead per slot level above 3. The separate animate-versus-reassert mode, source corpse/bones, and command/control details remain represented by separate open Animate Dead buckets.

corpseOrRemainsEligibility.notes: Animate Dead requires a pile of bones or corpse from a Medium or Small Humanoid for the animation branch.

effects.description: Animate one pile of bones or one corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within 10 feet, creating one persistent Undead for 24 hours: bones become a Skeleton and a corpse becomes a Zombie.

control.noCommandBehavior: Dodge and move only to avoid harm

specialActions.name: Mentally Command Animated Undead
specialActions.description: Issue the same mental command to one or more undead animated by Animate Dead within 60 feet.

effects.description: Choose bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within 10 feet to create a Skeleton or Zombie. For 24 hours, you can mentally command any Undead animated by this spell within 60 feet as a Bonus Action, issuing the same command to multiple controlled Undead; without commands they Dodge and move only to avoid harm, orders continue until complete, control stops after 24 hours unless recast before expiry, and higher slots animate or reassert control over two additional Undead per slot level above 3.

grantedActions.name: Mentally Command Animated Undead
grantedActions.description: On each of the caster's turns, the caster can use a Bonus Action to mentally command one or more Undead made by this spell within 60 feet, giving the same command to multiple controlled Undead.

undeadConversion.defaultBehaviorWithoutCommand: Dodge and move only to avoid harm

summonControl.multiCommand: can command any or all undead made by this spell with same command
summonControl.noCommandBehavior: Dodge and move only to avoid harm
summonControl.reassertControl: later cast can reassert control over existing undead made by this spell

aiContext.prompt: Choose whether this casting turns bones into a Skeleton, turns a corpse into a Zombie, or reasserts control over existing Undead animated by this spell.

options.label: Animate Skeleton from Bones
options.summary: Choose a pile of bones from a Medium or Small Humanoid within 10 feet; it becomes a Skeleton under the caster's control for 24 hours.
options.notes: Higher-level slots can animate additional Undead, each from a different pile of bones or corpse.

options.label: Animate Zombie from Corpse
options.summary: Choose a corpse from a Medium or Small Humanoid within 10 feet; it becomes a Zombie under the caster's control for 24 hours.
options.notes: Higher-level slots can animate additional Undead, each from a different corpse or pile of bones.

options.label: Reassert Control
options.summary: Cast before the current 24-hour control period ends to renew control over existing Undead animated by this spell instead of animating a new one.
options.notes: A level 3 slot reasserts control over up to four existing Undead; higher slots add two more controlled Undead per slot level above 3.

modeChoice.notes: The choice determines whether the target source creates a Skeleton, creates a Zombie, or refreshes control over existing Undead from this spell.

animate-dead.description: Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: a Skeleton if you chose bones or a Zombie if you chose a corpse. On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating a new creature.
animate-dead.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead creatures for each spell slot level above 3. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.

animate-objects.name: Animate Objects

effects.description: Animate eligible nonmagical unattended Huge-or-smaller objects within 120 feet for up to 1 minute with concentration. Object size counts against your spellcasting ability modifier limit, each object becomes an allied Construct that shares your initiative, you can command any within 500 feet as a Bonus Action, uncommanded objects Dodge and avoid harm, and each object reverts at 0 Hit Points with excess damage carrying over.

scaling.bonusPerLevel: Slam damage increases by object size per slot level above 5th
scaling.customFormula: Each slot level above 5th increases Slam damage by 1d4 for Medium-or-smaller objects, 1d6 for Large objects, or 1d12 for Huge objects.

grantedActions.notes: Mentally command any or all animated objects within 500 feet; without commands, they Dodge and avoid harm.

animatedObjectState.description: Animated objects use the Animated Object stat block immunity package while they remain animated.

lifecycle.hitPointEnding: animated construct remains under caster control until spell ends or it is reduced to 0 hit points
lifecycle.reversion: when the creature drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to object form
lifecycle.damageCarryover: remaining damage carries over to the original object form

communication.languageEntry: Understands the languages the caster knows
communication.commandChannel: caster mentally commands animated objects as described by existing control action data

control.maxObjects: caster spellcasting ability modifier worth of objects by size cost
control.commandScope: commands one or all animated objects to move and act
control.lifecycle: controlled until spell ends or object reaches 0 HP, then reverts with damage carryover

conditionalEndings.description: Control over an animated object ends when that creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points; it reverts to object form, and any remaining damage carries over to that form.

socialEffect.notes: Animated objects are allies to the caster and allies, understand the caster languages, and carry listed immunities.

aiContext.prompt: Choose eligible nonmagical unattended objects within 120 feet. Count each Medium or smaller object as 1, each Large object as 2, and each Huge object as 3 against the caster's spellcasting ability modifier limit; record the command issued to animated objects within 500 feet on later Bonus Actions.

animate-objects.description: Objects animate at your command. Choose a number of nonmagical objects within range that aren't being worn or carried, aren't fixed to a surface, and aren't Gargantuan. The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; for this number, a Medium or smaller target counts as one object, a Large target counts as two, and a Huge target counts as three. Each target animates, sprouts legs, and becomes a Construct that uses the Animated Object stat block; this creature is under your control until the spell ends or until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each creature you make with this spell is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count and takes its turn immediately after yours. Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. When the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it reverts to its object form, and any remaining damage carries over to that form.
animate-objects.higherLevels: The creature's Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large), or 1d12 (Huge) for each spell slot level above 5. Huge or Smaller Construct, Unaligned AC 15 HP 10 (Medium or smaller), 20 (Large), 40 (Huge) Speed 30 ft. Immunities Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned Senses Blindsight 30 ft.; Passive Perception 6 Languages Understands the languages you know CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus) Slam. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: Force damage equal to 1d4 + 3 (Medium or smaller), 2d6 + 3 + your spellcasting ability modifier (Large), or 2d12 + 3 + your spellcasting ability modifier (Huge).

antilife-shell.name: Antilife Shell

barrierState.blockedCreatureRule: Creatures other than Constructs and Undead cannot pass or reach through the aura.

effects.description: Creates a 10-foot moving emanation around the caster that blocks living creatures except Constructs and Undead from passing through or reaching through it; ranged attacks, reach attacks, and spells can still cross the barrier.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends if the caster moves so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier.

aiContext.prompt: Track the 10-foot caster-centered Emanation; block creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it, allow ranged attacks, reach weapons, and spells through, and end the spell if caster movement forces an affected creature through the barrier.

antilife-shell.description: An aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

antimagic-field.name: Antimagic Field

effects.description: Creates a 10-foot moving antimagic emanation around the caster that suppresses spellcasting, magical effects, teleportation, summoned creatures, and magic-item properties inside the aura.

controlOptions.name: Spellcasting suppression
controlOptions.effect: No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura.

controlOptions.name: Magic item suppression
controlOptions.effect: Magical properties of magic items do not work inside the aura or on anything inside it.

controlOptions.name: Area exclusion
controlOptions.effect: Areas of effect created by spells or other magic cannot extend into the aura.

controlOptions.name: Teleport and planar block
controlOptions.effect: No one can teleport into or out of the aura or use planar travel there.

controlOptions.name: Portal suppression
controlOptions.effect: Portals close temporarily while in the aura.

controlOptions.name: Ongoing spell suppression
controlOptions.effect: Ongoing spells are suppressed in the area except those cast by an Artifact or deity; suppressed time still counts against duration.
controlOptions.details: Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and different Antimagic Field auras do not nullify each other.

antimagic-field.description: An aura of antimagic surrounds you in 10-foot Emanation . No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can't target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don't work inside the aura or on anything inside it. Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can't extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura. Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don't nullify each other.

antipathy-sympathy.name: Antipathy/Sympathy

components.materialDescription: a mix of vinegar and honey

affectedCreatureKindSelection.notes: After choosing Antipathy or Sympathy, the caster specifies the kind of creature affected by the aura.

effects.description: Choose Antipathy or Sympathy for one Huge-or-smaller creature or object within 60 feet, then name the affected creature kind. Creatures of that kind make Wisdom saves when they come within 120 feet, repeat the save after ending a turn more than 120 feet away, gain 1 minute of immunity after a successful save, and Sympathy also prevents willing movement away within 5 feet unless target damage allows an ending save.

controlOptions.name: Antipathy
controlOptions.effect: Failed Wisdom save gives the Frightened condition and forces movement away from the target by the safest route.

controlOptions.name: Sympathy
controlOptions.effect: Failed Wisdom save gives the Charmed condition and forces movement toward the target by the safest route.
controlOptions.details: A Charmed creature within 5 feet of the target cannot willingly move away; damage by the target allows a Wisdom save to end the effect.

controlOptions.name: Ending the Effect
controlOptions.effect: If the affected creature ends its turn more than 120 feet from the target, it makes a Wisdom save; a successful save ends the effect and grants 1 minute of immunity.

effects.description: Antipathy mode: a creature of the chosen kind that fails the Wisdom saving throw has the Frightened condition and must move away from the target by the safest route.
Sympathy mode: a creature of the chosen kind that fails the Wisdom saving throw has the Charmed condition and must move toward the target by the safest route.
Affected creatures must use their movement on their turns to move by the safest route either away from the target for Antipathy or toward the target for Sympathy.

forcedMovement.maxDistance: as far as possible away from or as close as possible to the target, depending on the chosen mode

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose Antipathy or Sympathy and specify the kind of creature affected by the target.

antipathy-sympathy.description: As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy, and target one creature or object that is Huge or smaller. Then specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. A creature of the chosen kind makes a Wisdom saving throw when it comes within 120 feet of the target. Your choice of antipathy or sympathy determines what happens to a creature when it fails that save: Antipathy. The creature has the Frightened condition. The Frightened creature must use its movement on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route. Sympathy. The creature has the Charmed condition. The Charmed creature must use its movement on its turns to get as close as possible to the target, moving by the safest route. If the creature is within 5 feet of the target, the creature can't willingly move away. If the target damages the Charmed creature, that creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as described below. Ending the Effect. If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

arcane-eye.name: Arcane Eye

measuredDetails.label: Eye Darkvision Range
measuredDetails.notes: The eye can see in every direction with this Darkvision range.

measuredDetails.label: Opening Allowance
measuredDetails.notes: The eye can pass through an opening this small.

measuredDetails.label: Move Distance
measuredDetails.notes: As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye this far in any direction.

effects.description: Creates an invisible invulnerable sensor with all-around vision, 30-foot Darkvision, mental visual feed to the caster, and bonus-action 30-foot movement through openings at least 1 inch wide.

sensorState.description: The spell creates an Invisible, invulnerable, hovering eye sensor that can move through openings at least 1 inch wide and feed visual information to the caster.

grantedActions.action: Move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction.
grantedActions.notes: A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but it can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

visionLightSound.movement: bonus action moves eye up to 30 feet
visionLightSound.passageLimit: can pass through openings at least 1 inch in diameter

aiContext.prompt: Create an Invisible, invulnerable hovering eye sensor. Track all-direction vision, 30-foot Darkvision, mental visual feed, and Bonus Action movement up to 30 feet through openings at least 1 inch wide.

arcane-eye.description: You create an Invisible, invulnerable eye within range that hovers for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which can see in every direction. It also has Darkvision with a range of 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

arcane-gate.name: Arcane Gate

placementEligibility.notes: Arcane Gate requires two Large unoccupied ground spaces the caster can see: one within 10 feet and one within range.

effects.description: Create two linked 10-foot-diameter portals for up to 10 minutes with concentration: one on a ground point within 10 feet of you and one on a visible ground point within 500 feet. The spell fails if either portal would open in an occupied space, each portal is open only from one chosen side, opaque mist blocks sight through it, creatures and objects entering the open side exit the other portal as though the spaces were adjacent, and you can reverse the open sides with a Bonus Action.

surfaceInteraction.notes: The two Arcane Gate portals occupy Large unoccupied ground spaces, hover inches above the ground, and stand perpendicular to it.

visionLightSound.casterSightRequirement: choose two Large unoccupied ground spaces caster can see
visionLightSound.portalAppearance: two-dimensional glowing rings filled with mist
visionLightSound.facing: open on only one chosen side, reversible with Bonus Action

planarMovement.origin: ground point within 10 feet of caster
planarMovement.failure: spell fails if either portal would open in occupied space
planarMovement.travel: creatures entering one portal exit the other

aiContext.prompt: Choose two Large unoccupied ground spaces: one within 500 feet and one within 10 feet of the caster. Choose which side of each portal is open, and on later Bonus Actions choose whether to reverse the open sides.

arcane-gate.description: You create linked teleportation portals. Choose two Large, unoccupied spaces on the ground that you can see, one space within range and the other one within 10 feet of you. A circular portal opens in each of those spaces and remains for the duration. The portals are two-dimensional glowing rings filled with mist that blocks sight. They hover inches from the ground and are perpendicular to it. A portal is open on only one side (you choose which). Anything entering the open side of a portal exits from the open side of the other portal as if the two were adjacent to each other. As a Bonus Action, you can change the facing of the open sides.

arcane-lock.name: Arcane Lock

components.materialDescription: gold dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

effects.description: Magically locks the target object so it can't be unlocked by nonmagical means. Designated creatures can open and close it despite the lock, and an optional password spoken within 5 feet unlocks it for 1 minute.

objectAccessChange.notes: Arcane Lock changes a closed access object into a magical lock that blocks nonmagical unlocking while preserving designated creature access and optional password access.

arcane-lock.description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch and magically lock it for the duration. This lock can't be unlocked by any nonmagical means. You and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open and close the object despite the lock. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, unlocks it for 1 minute.

arcane-sword.name: Arcane Sword

components.materialDescription: A miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp

effects.description: When the sword appears, the caster makes a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Force damage.
On later turns before the spell ends, the caster can use a Bonus Action to repeat the sword's melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Force damage.
Until the spell ends, the caster can use a bonus action each turn to move the hovering sword up to 20 feet to a spot the caster can see.

Create a hovering sword-shaped plane of force within range for up to 1 minute with concentration. When it appears, the caster makes a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the sword, and on later turns can use a Bonus Action to move the sword up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against the same or a different target.

controlOptions.name: Create Hovering Sword
controlOptions.effect: The caster creates a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range.

controlOptions.name: Initial Melee Spell Attack
controlOptions.effect: When the sword appears, the caster makes a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the sword.

controlOptions.name: Bonus Action Move And Attack

arcane-sword.description: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit. the target takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.

arcane-vigor.name: Arcane Vigor

effects.description: You expend one or two unexpended Hit Point Dice, roll them, add your spellcasting ability modifier, and regain that many Hit Points. The rolled dice are expended.

hitPointState.healingFormula: rolled Hit Point Dice total + spellcasting ability modifier

arcane-vigor.description: You tap into your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll's total plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Those dice are then expended.
arcane-vigor.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The number of unexpended Hit Dice you can roll increases by one for each spell slot level above 2.

armor-of-agathys.name: Armor of Agathys

effects.description: The caster gains temporary hit point protection, increasing by 5 temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends early if the caster has no Temporary Hit Points from this spell.

hitPointState.notes: Temporary hit points and retaliation damage scale together.

effects.description: A creature that hits the protected caster takes 5 Cold damage, increasing by 5 for each slot level above 1st.

conditionalEndings.description: The retaliatory cold damage is available only while the spell remains active; the spell ends when its Temporary Hit Points are gone.

armor-of-agathys.description: Protective magical frost surrounds you. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points . If a creature hits you with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, the creature takes 5 Cold damage. The spell ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points.
armor-of-agathys.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Temporary Hit Points and the Cold damage both increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 1.

arms-of-hadar.name: Arms of Hadar

effects.description: Creatures in the 10-foot emanation make a Strength save against 2d6 Necrotic damage, taking half damage on a success; damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.
Creatures in the 10-foot Emanation that fail the Strength save cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn.

arms-of-hadar.description: Invoking Hadar, you cause tendrils to erupt from yourself. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.
arms-of-hadar.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

astral-projection.name: Astral Projection

components.materialDescription: for each of the spell's targets, one jacinth worth 1,000+ GP and one silver bar worth 100+ GP, all of which the spell consumes

effects.description: Project the caster and up to eight willing creatures into the Astral Plane unless the caster is already there. Each astral form travels by silver cord, cord-cutting kills both forms, body and astral-form damage stay separate, leaving the Astral Plane pulls the body and possessions to the new plane, either form dropping to 0 Hit Points ends the spell for that target, and the caster can dismiss the spell for all targets with a Magic action.

grantedActions.action: Take a Magic action to dismiss Astral Projection for all targets.
grantedActions.notes: The current granted-action schema cannot name the Magic action subtype separately from a normal action.

controlOptions.name: Astral projection
controlOptions.effect: The caster and up to eight willing creatures project astral bodies into the Astral Plane; the spell ends instantly if the caster is already there.

controlOptions.name: Suspended body
controlOptions.effect: Each target body is left behind Unconscious, needs no food or air, and does not age.

controlOptions.name: Silver cord
controlOptions.effect: The astral form has a silvery cord; if an effect explicitly cuts it, both body and astral form die.

controlOptions.name: Planar re-entry
controlOptions.effect: When an astral form leaves the Astral Plane, the body and possessions travel along the cord and the target re-enters its body on the new plane.

controlOptions.name: Damage separation
controlOptions.effect: Damage and other effects on an astral form do not affect the body, and damage and effects on the body do not affect the astral form.

controlOptions.name: Magic-action dismissal
controlOptions.effect: The caster can take a Magic action to dismiss the spell for all targets; a target also returns when the spell ends for it while it is not dead.

createdObjects.name: Suspended Original Body
createdObjects.notes: The body is left behind Unconscious in suspended animation until the spell ends for that target, unless the target dies.

createdObjects.name: Astral Form
createdObjects.notes: The astral form replicates the target's statistics and possessions, travels through the Astral Plane, and pulls the body and possessions along the silver cord when leaving that plane.

hitPointState.zeroHpEnding: spell ends for a target if its body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points
hitPointState.silverCordCut: target dies if silver cord is cut

effects.description: Each target body left behind by Astral Projection is suspended with the Unconscious condition, needs no food or air, does not age, and exits suspended animation when the spell ends for that target while it is not dead.

astral-projection.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). Each target's body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; it has the Unconscious condition, doesn't need food or air, and doesn't age. A target's astral form resembles its body in almost every way, replicating its game statistics and possessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that trails from between the shoulder blades of the astral form. The cord fades from view after 1 foot. If the cord is cut-which happens only when an effect states that it does so-the target's body and astral form both die. A target's astral form can travel through the Astral Plane. The moment an astral form leaves that plane, the target's body and possessions travel along the silver cord, causing the target to re-enter its body on the new plane. Any damage or other effects that apply to an astral form have no effect on the target's body and vice versa. If a target's body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends for that target. The spell ends for all the targets if you take a Magic action to dismiss it. When the spell ends for a target who isn't dead, the target reappears in its body and exits the state of suspended animation.

augury.name: Augury

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinatory tokens worth 25+ GP; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

components.materialDescription: specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinatory tokens worth 25+ GP

effects.description: Receive an omen (Weal, Woe, Weal and Woe, or Nothing) about a specific course of action to be taken within the next 30 minutes. Repeated casting before a long rest can give random results.

knowledgeEffect.notes: Augury returns one omen about a planned course of action within 30 minutes and does not account for later circumstances that change the result.

augury.description: You receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses the omen from the Omens table. The spell doesn't account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

aura-of-life.name: Aura of Life

effects.description: For up to 10 minutes with concentration, life-preserving energy radiates from the caster in a 30-foot aura that moves with the caster and affects nonhostile creatures in the aura.
For up to 10 minutes with concentration, nonhostile creatures in the 30-foot aura, including the caster, have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
For up to 10 minutes with concentration, nonhostile creatures in the 30-foot aura cannot have their Hit Point maximum reduced.
A nonhostile living creature regains 1 Hit Point when it starts its turn in the 30-foot aura with 0 Hit Points.

aura-of-life.description: Life-preserving energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) has resistance to necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum can't be reduced. In addition, a nonhostile, living creature regains 1 hit point when it starts its turn in the aura with 0 hit points.

aura-of-purity.name: Aura of Purity

effects.description: A 30-foot aura of purifying energy radiates from the caster for up to 10 minutes with concentration, moves with the caster, and prevents nonhostile creatures in the aura from becoming diseased.

diseaseImmunity.description: Nonhostile creatures in the caster-centered aura cannot become diseased while they remain in the aura.

effects.description: Nonhostile creatures in the aura, including the caster, have Resistance to Poison damage.
Nonhostile creatures in the aura have Advantage on saving throws against effects that cause Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

aiContext.prompt: Maintain the caster-centered 30-foot aura; for nonhostile creatures in it, block disease, apply Poison resistance, and grant Advantage on saves against effects that would cause Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

aura-of-purity.description: Purifying energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) can't become diseased, has resistance to poison damage, and has advantage on saving throws against effects that cause any of the following conditions: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned.

aura-of-vitality.name: Aura of Vitality

effects.description: When the aura is created, restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in the 30-foot emanation.
At the start of each of the caster's turns while the aura persists, restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in it.

aura-of-vitality.description: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it persists, you can restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in it.

awaken.name: Awaken

components.materialDescription: an agate worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

effects.description: The awakened Beast or Plant is Charmed for 30 days or until the caster or the caster's allies damage it, then chooses its attitude when the condition ends.

conditionalEndings.description: The Charmed condition ends early if the caster or the caster's allies deal damage to the awakened target.

socialEffect.notes: The awakened target is Charmed for 30 days or until harmed by the caster or allies, then chooses its attitude.

effects.description: After the 8-hour casting with a consumed 1,000 GP gemstone, touch a Beast or Plant creature with Intelligence 3 or less, or a natural plant that is not a creature; the target gains Intelligence 10 and one language the caster knows, and a noncreature plant becomes a Plant creature with movement, humanlike senses, and DM-chosen statistics.

eligibleTargets: Beast creature with Intelligence 3 or less
Plant creature with Intelligence 3 or less
natural plant that is not a creature
plantInteraction.notes: Awaken can transform a natural plant object into a Plant creature with movement, senses, Intelligence 10, language, and DM-chosen statistics; the existing status row handles the 30-day Charmed relationship.

knowledgeEffect.notes: Awaken grants Intelligence 10 and the ability to speak one language known by the caster.

communicationDetails.targetEligibility: Beast or Plant creature with Intelligence 3 or less, or natural noncreature plant
communicationDetails.plantCreatureResult: natural plant becomes Plant creature with humanlike senses and movement as appropriate
communicationDetails.notes: Awaken grants lasting speech capability in one language the caster knows.

aiContext.prompt: Choose the eligible Beast, Plant creature, or natural plant touched at the end of the 8-hour casting. Choose one language the caster knows for the awakened target; if a natural plant becomes a creature, record the DM-chosen stat profile such as Awakened Shrub or Awakened Tree, and record the awakened creature's attitude when the Charmed condition ends.

awaken.description: You spend the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, and then touch the target. The target must be either a Beast or Plant creature with an Intelligence of 3 or less or a natural plant that isn't a creature. The target gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. If the target is a natural plant, it becomes a Plant creature and gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth, and it gains senses similar to a human's. The DM chooses statistics appropriate for the awakened Plant, such as the statistics for the Awakened Shrub or Awakened Tree in the Monster Manual . The awakened target has the Charmed condition for 30 days or until you or your allies deal damage to it. When that condition ends, the awakened creature chooses its attitude toward you.

bane.name: Bane

effects.description: Up to three visible creatures within 30 feet make a Charisma save; failed saves apply the Bane modifier for up to 1 minute with concentration, subtracting 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws. Higher slots add one target per slot level above 1.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose up to three visible creatures within 30 feet; failed Charisma saves subtract 1d4 from each affected target's attack rolls and saving throws while Bane lasts.

bane.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.
bane.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

banishing-smite.name: Banishing Smite

effects.description: The next time the caster hits a creature with an attack roll during the spell's duration, the attack deals an extra 5d10 Force damage.
If the triggering attack reduces the target to 50 Hit Points or fewer, the target must succeed on a Charisma save or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration.

conditionalEndings.description: When the spell ends, the transported target reappears in the space it left or nearest unoccupied space if occupied.

planarMovement.returnPlacement: space left or nearest unoccupied space when spell ends

planarMovement.returnPlacement: space left or nearest unoccupied space when spell ends

aiContext.prompt: On the next attack-roll hit, add 5d10 Force damage; if the target is reduced to 50 Hit Points or fewer after that damage, resolve the Charisma save, then banish and Incapacitate the target on failure until the spell ends.

If the attack reduces the target to 50 Hit Points or fewer, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

banishment.name: Banishment

effects.description: One visible creature within 30 feet that fails a Charisma save is transported to a harmless demiplane for up to 1 minute with concentration and is Incapacitated while there; when the spell ends, it returns to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

conditionalEndings.description: Target reappears in the space it left or nearest unoccupied space when the spell ends.
If the full minute completes against a listed extraplanar type, target does not return and is sent to an associated plane.

planarMovement.normalReturn: returns to departure space or nearest unoccupied space when spell ends

If the full minute completes against a listed extraplanar type, target does not return and is sent to an associated plane.

banishment.description: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.
banishment.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

barkskin.name: Barkskin

effects.description: Touch one willing creature for 1 hour; the target has AC 17 if its Armor Class would otherwise be lower.

barkskin.description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin assumes a bark-like appearance, and the target has an Armor Class of 17 if its AC is lower than that.

beacon-of-hope.name: Beacon of Hope

effects.description: Choose any number of creatures within 30 feet for up to 1 minute with concentration; each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

savingThrowModifier.notes: Each chosen target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws while Beacon of Hope lasts.

effects.description: Each chosen target has Advantage on Death Saving Throws for up to 1 minute with concentration.

savingThrowModifier.notes: Each chosen target has Advantage on Death Saving Throws while Beacon of Hope lasts.

effects.description: Each chosen target regains the maximum possible Hit Points from any healing received for up to 1 minute with concentration.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose any number of creatures within 30 feet; apply Advantage on Wisdom saves, Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and maximum possible healing received while the spell lasts.

beacon-of-hope.description: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

beast-sense.name: Beast Sense

requirements.description: The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

effects.description: Perceive through the willing Beast's senses as well as your own for the duration, gaining the benefit of any special senses it has.

beast-sense.description: You touch a willing Beast. For the duration, you can perceive through the Beast's senses as well as your own. When perceiving through the Beast's senses, you benefit from any special senses it has.

befuddlement.name: Befuddlement

components.materialDescription: a handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres

effects.description: One visible creature within 150 feet takes 10d12 Psychic damage and makes an Intelligence save. On a failed save, it has the Stunned condition and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
On a failed Intelligence save, the creature has the Stunned condition until the end of the caster's next turn, then repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.

befuddlement.description: You attempt to befuddle a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 10d12 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target also has the Stunned condition for 1 minute. The Stunned target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Alternatively, casting Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish on the target ends the effect.

bestow-curse.name: Bestow Curse

effects.description: Touch one creature and force a Wisdom save; on a failure, choose one curse for the duration: Disadvantage on checks and saves with one ability score, Disadvantage on attacks against you, a start-turn Wisdom save that can waste the target action, +1d8 Necrotic damage from your attacks and spells, or a DM-approved alternative no stronger than those options. Remove Curse ends the curse, and higher slots extend duration or remove Concentration as listed in the scaling table.

abilityCheckModifier.appliesTo: ability checks using the chosen ability
abilityCheckModifier.notes: Ability Curse option only: the cursed target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the ability chosen by the caster.

attackRollModifier.notes: Attack Curse option only: the cursed target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the caster.

bestow-curse.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you cast this spell using a level 4 spell slot, you can maintain Concentration on it for up to 10 minutes. If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell doesn't require Concentration, and the duration becomes 8 hours (level 5-6 slot) or 24 hours (level 7-8 slot). If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.

entries.4: duration up to 10 minutes with concentration

bigbys-hand.name: Bigby's Hand

components.materialDescription: An eggshell and a snakeskin glove

placementEligibility.notes: The Large force hand is created in an unoccupied visible space within 120 feet.

effects.description: Create a Large shimmering force hand in a visible unoccupied space within 120 feet for up to 1 minute with concentration. When cast and on later Bonus Actions, the caster can move the hand up to 60 feet and choose Clenched Fist, Forceful Hand, Grasping Hand, or Interposing Hand; the hand has AC 20, Hit Points equal to the caster's Hit Point maximum, Strength 26, Dexterity 10, and the spell ends if the hand drops to 0 Hit Points.

scaling.bonusPerLevel: +2d8 clenched-fist damage and +2d6 grasping-hand damage per slot level above 5th
scaling.customFormula: Damage from the clenched fist option increases by 2d8 and damage from the grasping hand option increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

attackAugments.graspingHandCheck: Use the hand's Strength to grapple a Huge or smaller creature; Advantage if target is Medium or smaller.
attackAugments.crushDamage: 2d6 + spellcasting ability modifier Bludgeoning, +2d6 per slot level above 5.

controlOptions.scaling: +2d8 Force damage per slot level above 5th

controlOptions.label: Forceful Hand
controlOptions.summary: The hand pushes a creature within 5 feet in a direction chosen by the caster, using the hand's Strength contested by the target's Athletics.

controlOptions.label: Grasping Hand
controlOptions.summary: The hand grapples a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet and can later crush the grappled target for Bludgeoning damage.
controlOptions.scaling: +2d6 crush damage per slot level above 5th

controlOptions.label: Interposing Hand
controlOptions.summary: The hand interposes between the caster and a chosen creature, granting half cover and blocking or slowing that creature based on Strength.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends if the created hand object drops to 0 Hit Points.

terrainInteraction.notes: If a target overpowers the hand and moves toward the caster through the hand space, that space counts as Difficult Terrain for that target.

createdObjects.name: Bigby Hand

controlledEntity.durability: AC 20, HP equal caster maximum; spell ends at 0 HP
controlledEntity.notes: A controlled force object with mode-specific combat actions.

options.summary: Grapple a Huge or smaller creature and enable later crush damage.

modeChoice.notes: The selected command controls the hand's immediate or later Bonus Action behavior while the same created hand object remains active.

bigbys-hand.description: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand. The hand is an object that has AC 20 and hit points equal to your hit point maximum. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends. It has a Strength of 26 (+8) and a Dexterity of 10 (+0). The hand doesn't fill its space. When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and then cause one of the following effects with it. Clenched Fist. The hand strikes one creature or object within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack for the hand using your game statistics. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 force damage. Forceful Hand. The hand attempts to push a creature within 5 feet of it in a direction you choose. Make a check with the hand's Strength contested by the Strength (Athletics) check of the target. If the target is Medium or smaller, you have advantage on the check. If you succeed, the hand pushes the target up to 5 feet plus a number of feet equal to five times your spellcasting ability modifier. The hand moves with the target to remain within 5 feet of it. Grasping Hand. The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. You use the hand's Strength score to resolve the grapple. If the target is Medium or smaller, you have advantage on the check. While the hand is grappling the target, you can use a bonus action to have the hand crush it. When you do so, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 2d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Interposing Hand. The hand interposes itself between you and a creature you choose until you give the hand a different command. The hand moves to stay between you and the target, providing you with half cover against the target. The target can't move through the hand's space if its Strength score is less than or equal to the hand's Strength score. If its Strength score is higher than the hand's Strength score, the target can move toward you through the hand's space, but that space is difficult terrain for the target.
bigbys-hand.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage from the clenched fist option increases by 2d8 and the damage from the grasping hand increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

blade-barrier.name: Blade Barrier

effects.description: When the straight 100-foot-long, 20-foot-high, 5-foot-thick wall or 60-foot-diameter ring appears within 90 feet, creatures in the blade wall space make a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success; the wall provides Three-Quarters Cover and its space is Difficult Terrain.

A creature that enters the blade wall space for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success; a creature makes this save only once per turn.
A creature that ends its turn in the blade wall space makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success; a creature makes this save only once per turn.

areaOfEffect.notes: The canonical terrain is the wall's own space; Square is used here because the terrain effect validator does not currently accept Wall shapes.

effects.description: The blade wall space is Difficult Terrain for the spell duration.

Create a straight wall of whirling magical blades up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover.

createdObjects.name: Blade Barrier
createdObjects.notes: A magical wall of whirling blades. It can be a straight wall up to 100 feet long or a ring up to 60 feet in diameter, is 20 feet high and 5 feet thick, provides three-quarters cover, makes its own space difficult terrain, and damages creatures that appear in, enter, or end their turn in the wall once per turn.

blade-barrier.description: You create a wall of whirling blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover , and its space is Difficult Terrain . Any creature in the wall's space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that save if it enters the wall's space or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

measuredDetails.notes: The created planar rift is about 3 feet long.

aiContext.prompt: Choose an unoccupied visible space within 60 feet for the blade.
