blade-of-disaster.description: You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration. When you cast this spell, you can make up to two melee spell attacks with the blade, each one against a creature, loose object, or structure within 5 feet of the blade. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 force damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the number on the d20 is 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the blade deals an extra 8d12 force damage (for a total of 12d12 force damage). As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the blade up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see and then make up to two melee spell attacks with it again. The blade can harmlessly pass through any barrier, including a Wall of Force.

blade-ward.name: Blade Ward

attackRollModifier.notes: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against the caster before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

effects.description: Self only. For up to 1 minute with concentration, every incoming attack roll against the caster subtracts 1d4 while the spell remains active.

blade-ward.description: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

bless.name: Bless

effects.description: Up to three creatures within 30 feet gain the Blessed modifier for up to 1 minute with concentration, adding 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Higher slots add one target per slot level above 1.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose up to three creatures within 30 feet; each chosen target adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws while Bless lasts.

bless.description: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.
bless.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

blight.name: Blight

effects.description: One visible creature or plant object within 30 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success; Plant creatures automatically fail, nonmagical plants that are not creatures wither and die, and each slot level above 4 adds +1d8 damage.

plantInteraction.notes: Blight has a special plant branch: Plant creatures automatically fail the save, and nonmagical non-creature plants can be targeted directly to wither and die.

effects.description: Alternatively, target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub. It doesn't make a save; it simply withers and dies.

plantInteraction.notes: This utility branch records the non-creature plant object outcome separately from creature damage.

blight.description: A creature that you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Plant creature automatically fails the save. Alternatively, target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub. It doesn't make a save; it simply withers and dies.
blight.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

blinding-smite.name: Blinding Smite

combatCost.condition: after you hit a creature with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike

castingTime.reactionCondition: immediately after you hit a creature with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike

effects.description: The triggering weapon hit deals an extra 3d8 Radiant damage to the target, and each slot level above 3 adds +1d8 damage.
On the hit-based smite effect, applies Blinded for 1 minute; a turn-end Constitution save can end it, and slot scaling adds +1d8 damage.

blinding-smite.description: The target hit by the strike takes an extra 3d8 Radiant damage from the attack, and the target has the Blinded condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Blinded target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.
blinding-smite.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The extra damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3.

castingTrigger.notes: Routes the smite damage and blind-save payload through the shared attack-rider timing path.

blindness-deafness.name: Blindness/Deafness

effects.description: On a failed Constitution save, the target gains the Blinded condition for up to 1 minute and repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the condition on a success.
On a failed Constitution save, the target gains the Deafened condition for up to 1 minute and repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the condition on a success.

aiContext.prompt: Choose Blindness or Deafness for each target before resolving the Constitution save. On a failed save, apply the chosen condition for up to 1 minute and repeat the Constitution save at the end of each affected target's turns, ending the spell on that target on success.

blindness-deafness.description: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
blindness-deafness.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

options.label: Blindness
options.summary: The target is Blinded for the duration.

options.label: Deafness
options.summary: The target is Deafened for the duration.

blink.name: Blink

effects.description: For 1 minute, roll 1d6 at the end of each caster turn; on 4-6, the caster vanishes to the Ethereal Plane unless already there, perceives the original plane in gray out to 60 feet, can affect and be affected only by Ethereal creatures, returns at the start of the next turn or when the spell ends to a visible unoccupied space within 10 feet of the departure space, or the nearest unoccupied space if none is available.

conditionalEndings.description: When the end-of-turn Blink roll would send the caster to the Ethereal Plane, the spell ends instantly if the caster is already on that plane.

returnPlacementEligibility.notes: Blink returns the caster to a visible unoccupied space within 10 feet of the departure space, or the nearest unoccupied space if none is available.

visionLightSound.visualShift: while on the Ethereal Plane, the original plane appears in shades of gray
visionLightSound.interactionLimit: caster can affect and be affected only by creatures on the Ethereal Plane while shifted
visionLightSound.returnPlacement: returns to an unoccupied space of choice within 10 feet of the departure space that the caster can see

planarMovement.trigger: roll 4-6 on d6 at end of caster turn
planarMovement.alreadyThere: spell ends instantly if caster is already on Ethereal Plane
planarMovement.returnTiming: start of caster next turn and when spell ends if still Ethereal
planarMovement.returnPlacement: visible unoccupied space within 10 feet of departure space, otherwise nearest unoccupied space
planarMovement.interactionLimit: can affect and be affected only by Ethereal creatures while shifted

blink.description: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration. On a roll of 4-6, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). While on the Ethereal Plane, you can perceive the plane you left, which is cast in shades of gray, but you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. You can affect and be affected only by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and creatures on the other plane can't perceive you unless they have a special ability that lets them perceive things on the Ethereal Plane. You return to the other plane at the start of your next turn and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane. You return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you left. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space.

blur.name: Blur

attackRollModifier.notes: Attacker is immune if it perceives the caster with Blindsight or Truesight.

effects.description: Creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you; immune if they perceive you with Blindsight or Truesight.

blur.description: Your body becomes blurred. For the duration, any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight .

bones-of-the-earth.name: Bones of the Earth

forms.label: Stone Pillar
forms.notes: Up to six pillars can appear.

measuredDetails.label: Rubble Radius
measuredDetails.notes: A destroyed pillar leaves difficult terrain in this radius.

saveModifiers.condition: A creature can choose to fail the Dexterity save to be lifted by the pillar.

saveOutcomeOverrides.effect: The creature is lifted by the pillar.
If the pillar cannot reach full height, the creature takes 6d6 Bludgeoning damage and is Restrained until it escapes.

effects.description: If a pillar is blocked by a ceiling or other obstacle, a creature on the pillar makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d6 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or no damage on a success.

surfaceInteraction.notes: Each stone pillar bursts from a visible ground place wide enough for its 5-foot diameter; destroyed pillars leave difficult terrain rubble.

aiContext.prompt: Choose up to six valid ground points for stone pillars. For each Medium or smaller creature on a pillar point, record whether it voluntarily fails the Dexterity save; if a creature is restrained by a blocked pillar, choose whether its escape action uses Strength or Dexterity.

bones-of-the-earth.description: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see within range. Each pillar is a cylinder that has a diameter of 5 feet and a height of up to 30 feet. The ground where a pillar appears must be wide enough for its diameter, and you can target the ground under a creature if that creature is Medium or smaller. Each pillar has AC 5 and 30 hit points. When reduced to 0 hit points, a pillar crumbles into rubble, which creates an area of difficult terrain with a 10-foot radius that lasts until the rubble is cleared. Each 5-foot-diameter portion of the area requires at least 1 minute to clear by hand. If a pillar is created under a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be lifted by the pillar. A creature can choose to fail the save. If a pillar is prevented from reaching its full height because of a ceiling or other obstacle, a creature on the pillar takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained, pinched between the pillar and the obstacle. The restrained creature can use an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (the creature's choice) against the spell's save DC. On a success, the creature is no longer restrained and must either move off the pillar or fall off it.
bones-of-the-earth.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can create two additional pillars for each slot level above 6th.

booming-blade.name: Booming Blade

components.materialDescription: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

effects.description: On the melee weapon attack hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects and is sheathed in booming energy until the start of the caster's next turn; at character levels 5, 11, and 17 this hit also adds 1d8, 2d8, or 3d8 Thunder damage.

If the sheathed target willingly moves 5 feet or more before the start of the caster's next turn, it takes 1d8 Thunder damage and the spell ends; this movement damage becomes 2d8, 3d8, or 4d8 at character levels 5, 11, and 17.

booming-blade.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends.
booming-blade.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to 2d8. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 3d8) and again at 17th level (3d8 and 4d8).

burning-hands.name: Burning Hands

effects.description: Creatures in the 15-foot Cone make a Dexterity save against 3d6 Fire damage, taking half damage on a success; flammable objects in the Cone that are not worn or carried start burning, and damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.

createdObjects.name: Ignited Flammable Objects In Cone
createdObjects.notes: Burning Hands starts flammable objects in the Cone burning when they are not worn or carried.

burning-hands.description: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning .
burning-hands.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

call-lightning.name: Call Lightning

effects.description: Choose a visible point under the storm cloud; each creature within 5 feet of that point makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Outdoor storm control adds +1d10 damage, and each slot level above 3 adds +1d10 damage.

visionLightSound.cloudPlacement: storm cloud appears at a point the caster can see above them
visionLightSound.boltTargeting: caster chooses a point they can see under the cloud when the spell is cast or called again
visionLightSound.indoorLimit: spell fails if there is not room for the cloud to appear
visionLightSound.soundPayload: thunderous lightning impact implied by damage type, no separate audible command channel

effects.description: For up to 10 minutes with concentration, you can use a Magic action on later turns to call lightning again at the same point or a different point under the storm cloud.

grantedActions.notes: Call down lightning in that way again, targeting the same point or a different one.

createdObjects.name: Call Lightning Storm Cloud

visionLightSound.cloudPlacement: storm cloud appears at a point the caster can see above them
visionLightSound.boltTargeting: caster chooses a point they can see under the cloud when the spell is cast or called again
visionLightSound.indoorLimit: spell fails if there is not room for the cloud to appear
visionLightSound.soundPayload: thunderous lightning impact implied by damage type, no separate audible command channel

call-lightning.description: A storm cloud appears at a point within range that you can see above yourself. It takes the shape of a Cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius. When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see under the cloud. A lightning bolt shoots from the cloud to that point. Each creature within 5 feet of that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to call down lightning in that way again, targeting the same point or a different one. If you're outdoors in a storm when you cast this spell, the spell gives you control over that storm instead of creating a new one. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases by 1d10.
call-lightning.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 3.

calm-emotions.name: Calm Emotions

effects.description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet that fails the Charisma save can be chosen to gain immunity to Charmed and Frightened for up to 1 minute with concentration, suppressing any existing Charmed or Frightened condition for the same duration.

socialEffect.notes: One Calm Emotions mode makes affected Humanoids immune to Charmed and Frightened and suppresses those conditions for the duration.

effects.description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet that fails the Charisma save can instead become indifferent toward caster-chosen creatures it is hostile toward for up to 1 minute with concentration, ending early for that target if it takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage.

conditionalEndings.description: The indifference mode ends for the affected target if that target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage.

socialEffect.notes: The indifference mode ends if the target takes damage or sees its allies take damage.

calm-emotions.description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature): The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration. The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it's Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.

options.label: Suppress Charmed and Frightened
options.summary: A failed-save Humanoid gains immunity to Charmed and Frightened, suppressing either condition if already present.
options.notes: The spell text says the caster chooses the effect for each failed-save creature, so runtime should allow per-target mode assignment.

options.label: Make Hostile Creature Indifferent
options.summary: A failed-save Humanoid becomes Indifferent about caster-chosen creatures it is Hostile toward.
options.notes: This mode ends early for an affected target if it takes damage or witnesses allies taking damage.

modeChoice.notes: Unlike most choose-one menus, Calm Emotions chooses the mode separately for each failed-save Humanoid in the area.

catapult.name: Catapult

effects.description: A hurled object travels through a 90-foot line and deals 3d8 Bludgeoning damage to the first target that fails a Dexterity save; damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

Choose one object within 60 feet weighing 1 to 5 pounds that is not worn or carried; the maximum target weight increases by 5 pounds per slot level above 1, the object flies up to 90 feet in a straight line before falling, stops early if it impacts a solid surface or a creature that fails the Dexterity save, and the object plus whatever it strikes each take the collision damage.

surfaceInteraction.notes: The hurled object travels in a straight line, stops early when it hits a solid surface or target, and otherwise falls to the ground at the end of its path.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose one eligible loose object within 60 feet and the straight-line direction it flies; the first creature it would strike makes the Dexterity save before collision damage is applied.

catapult.description: Choose one object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within range that isn't being worn or carried. The object flies in a straight line up to 90 feet in a direction you choose before falling to the ground, stopping early if it impacts against a solid surface. If the object would strike a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object strikes the target and stops moving. When the object strikes something, the object and what it strikes each take 3d8 bludgeoning damage.
catapult.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the maximum weight of objects that you can target with this spell increases by 5 pounds, and the damage increases by 1d8, for each slot level above 1st.

catnap.name: Catnap

effects.description: Choose up to three willing visible creatures within 30 feet; each falls Unconscious for 10 minutes, wakes early if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake or slap it awake, gains the benefit of a Short Rest if it remains Unconscious for the full duration, cannot benefit from this spell again until finishing a Long Rest, and higher slots add one willing target per slot level above 3.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose up to three willing visible creatures within 30 feet; apply Unconscious for 10 minutes, wake a target early if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake or slap it awake, and mark full-duration targets as receiving a Short Rest and becoming ineligible for Catnap again until a Long Rest.

catnap.description: You make a calming gesture, and up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range fall unconscious for the spell's duration. The spell ends on a target early if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. If a target remains unconscious for the full duration, that target gains the benefit of a short rest, and it can't be affected by this spell again until it finishes a long rest.
catnap.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional willing creature for each slot level above 3rd.

chain-lightning.name: Chain Lightning

effects.description: A lightning bolt hits one visible creature or object within 150 feet, then leaps to up to three different creatures or objects within 30 feet of the first target; each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success, and each slot level above 6 adds one additional leaping bolt.

aiContext.prompt: Choose the first visible creature or object within 150 feet, then choose up to three different secondary creature or object targets within 30 feet of the first target. Each target can be hit by only one bolt.

chain-lightning.description: You launch a lightning bolt toward a target you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets of your choice, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
chain-lightning.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. One additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above 6.

charm-monster.name: Charm Monster

saveModifiers.reason: The target has Advantage on the Wisdom saving throw if the caster or the caster's allies are fighting it.

charmState.description: While Charmed by this spell, the creature is Friendly to the caster; when the spell ends, it knows the caster Charmed it.

effects.description: One visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save, with Advantage if the caster or the caster's allies are fighting it; on a failed save, it is Charmed for up to 1 hour and the condition ends early if the caster or allies damage it.

conditionalEndings.description: The Charmed condition ends early if the caster or the caster's allies damage the target.

socialEffect.notes: Charm Monster makes the failed-save creature Friendly to the caster, with save advantage if fighting, early ending on harm, and awareness when it ends.

aiContext.prompt: Prompt the Wisdom save, including Advantage if the caster or allies are fighting the target. On failure, apply Charmed, mark the creature Friendly to the caster, end early if the caster or allies damage it, and reveal to the target that the caster Charmed it when the spell ends.

charm-monster.description: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
charm-monster.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

charm-person.name: Charm Person

saveModifiers.reason: The target has advantage on the saving throw if you or your companions are fighting it.

effects.description: One target within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed for 1 hour; higher slots add one target per slot level.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends if the caster or one of the caster's allies damages the target.

socialEffect.notes: Charm Person makes the failed-save Humanoid Friendly to the caster, with save advantage if fighting and early ending on harm.

effects.description: The spell ends early if you or your companions do anything harmful to the creature. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.

conditionalEndings.description: When this damage break condition ends the spell, the target knows it was charmed by the caster.

knowledgeEffect.notes: When Charm Person ends, the target knows it was charmed by the caster.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose the visible Humanoid target or targets; if the caster or allies are fighting a target, that target rolls the Wisdom save with Advantage.

charm-person.description: One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
charm-person.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

chill-touch.name: Chill Touch

effects.description: On a melee spell hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, with cantrip-tier damage scaling at character levels 5, 11, and 17.
On a melee spell hit, the target gains the No Healing condition and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of the caster's next turn.
On a melee spell hit against an Undead target, that target gains Disadvantage on attacks against the caster until the end of the caster's next turn.

chill-touch.description: Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.
chill-touch.higherLevels: Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

chromatic-orb.name: Chromatic Orb

secondaryTargeting.notes: If two or more damage dice match, the orb can leap to a different target within 30 feet of the current target. Each chain step makes a new attack and damage roll; higher-slot casts can leap up to the slot level, and each creature can be targeted only once per casting.

effects.description: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, then make a ranged spell attack against one target within 90 feet. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type; if two or more damage dice match, the orb can leap to a different target within 30 feet and repeat the attack and damage roll, with higher slots increasing both damage and maximum leaps.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, make the ranged spell attack, and if duplicate damage dice trigger a leap, choose each new eligible target within 30 feet and roll a new attack and damage roll.

chromatic-orb.description: You hurl an orb of energy at a target within range. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type. If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the orb leaps to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll. The orb can't leap again unless you cast the spell with a level 2+ spell slot.
chromatic-orb.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1. The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended, and a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

options.label: Acid
options.summary: The orb deals Acid damage on a hit.

options.label: Cold
options.summary: The orb deals Cold damage on a hit.

options.label: Fire
options.summary: The orb deals Fire damage on a hit.

options.label: Lightning
options.summary: The orb deals Lightning damage on a hit.

options.label: Poison
options.summary: The orb deals Poison damage on a hit.

options.label: Thunder
options.summary: The orb deals Thunder damage on a hit.

modeChoice.notes: The damage packet already uses damage.damageTypeSource = chosen_damage_type; this menu supplies the six legal caster choices.

circle-of-death.name: Circle of Death

components.materialDescription: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP

effects.description: Each creature in the 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 150 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success; each slot level above 6 adds +2d8 damage.

circle-of-death.description: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
circle-of-death.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

circle-of-power.name: Circle of Power

effects.description: Friendly creatures in the 30-foot sphere, including the caster, have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
When a protected friendly creature succeeds on a save against a spell or magical effect that normally deals half damage on success, it takes no damage instead.

aiContext.prompt: Maintain the caster-centered 30-foot sphere; friendly creatures in it gain Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and successful half-damage saves against those effects become no damage.

circle-of-power.description: Divine energy radiates from you, distorting and diffusing magical energy within 30 feet of you. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you. For the duration, each friendly creature in the area (including you) has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Additionally, when an affected creature succeeds on a saving throw made against a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throws.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance

components.materialDescription: a focus worth 100+ GP, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing

effects.description: Create an invisible, intangible, invulnerable sensor within 1 mile for up to 10 minutes with concentration, placed in a familiar location or an obvious unfamiliar one; choose sight or hearing through the sensor, switch senses as a Bonus Action, and creatures with See Invisibility or Truesight see it as a fist-sized luminous orb.

visionLightSound.sensorVisibility: Invisible; creatures with See Invisibility or Truesight can see it as a luminous orb
visionLightSound.placement: familiar location within range or obvious unfamiliar location such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove
visionLightSound.senseMode: caster chooses seeing or hearing when cast and can switch senses as a Bonus Action

aiContext.prompt: Choose whether the sensor starts with seeing or hearing; the caster can switch between those senses later as a Bonus Action.

options.label: Seeing
options.summary: Use sight through the invisible sensor as if standing in its space.
options.notes: The caster can switch from seeing to hearing with a Bonus Action while the spell persists.

options.label: Hearing
options.summary: Use hearing through the invisible sensor as if standing in its space.
options.notes: The caster can switch from hearing to seeing with a Bonus Action while the spell persists.

modeChoice.notes: The mode choice controls which sense is active through the sensor; the sensor placement remains ordinary point targeting.

clairvoyance.description: You create an Invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The intangible, invulnerable sensor remains in place for the duration. When you cast the spell, choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As a Bonus Action, you can switch between seeing and hearing. A creature that sees the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from See Invisibility or Truesight) sees a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

clone.name: Clone

components.materialDescription: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes, and a sealable vessel worth 2,000+ GP that is large enough to hold the creature being cloned

effects.description: Creates an inert duplicate body that matures over 120 days and can receive the original creature's soul if the original later dies and the soul is free and willing.

controlOptions.name: Clone formation
controlOptions.effect: An inert duplicate forms inside the vessel and finishes growing after 120 days.
controlOptions.details: The caster chooses whether the finished clone is the same age as the creature or younger; the clone remains inert indefinitely while the vessel is undisturbed.

controlOptions.name: Soul transfer
controlOptions.effect: If the original creature dies after the clone finishes forming, the soul transfers to the clone if free and willing.

controlOptions.name: Original remains
controlOptions.effect: The clone has the same personality, memories, and abilities but none of the original equipment; original remains become inert and cannot be revived.

createdObjects.name: Inert Clone Body
createdObjects.notes: The clone remains inert indefinitely while its vessel is undisturbed, then receives the original creature's soul if the original dies after maturity and the soul is free and willing.

aiContext.prompt: Track the 120-day clone growth, vessel disturbance, caster age choice, free-and-willing soul transfer, and original remains becoming inert if the clone activates.

clone.description: You touch a creature or at least 1 cubic inch of its flesh. An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel used in the spell's casting and finishes growing after 120 days; you choose whether the finished clone is the same age as the creature or younger. The clone remains inert and endures indefinitely while its vessel remains undisturbed. If the original creature dies after the clone finishes forming, the creature's soul transfers to the clone if the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original's equipment. The creature's original remains, if any, become inert and can't be revived, since the creature's soul is elsewhere.

cloud-of-daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers

effects.description: Each creature in the Cube takes 4d4 Slashing damage when the spell is cast.
A creature takes 4d4 Slashing damage the first time on a turn that it enters the Cube or when the Cube moves into its space; this can happen only once per turn and gains +2d4 per slot level above 2.
A creature takes 4d4 Slashing damage when it ends its turn in the Cube.

cloud-of-daggers.description: You conjure spinning daggers in a 5-foot Cube centered on a point within range. Each creature in that area takes 4d4 Slashing damage. A creature also takes this damage if it enters the Cube or ends its turn there or if the Cube moves into its space. A creature takes this damage only once per turn. On your later turns, you can take a Magic action to teleport the Cube up to 30 feet.
cloud-of-daggers.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 2.

cloudkill.name: Cloudkill

effects.description: When the 20-foot-radius fog sphere appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much on a success; each slot level above 5 adds +1d8 damage.

The first time on a turn that a creature enters the fog sphere or the sphere moves into its space, it makes a Constitution save, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much on a success; each slot level above 5 adds +1d8 damage.
A creature that ends its turn in the fog sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much on a success; each slot level above 5 adds +1d8 damage.

Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green, Heavily Obscured fog for up to 10 minutes with concentration. Strong wind disperses the fog and ends the spell, and the sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

createdObjects.name: Cloudkill Fog Sphere
createdObjects.shelfLife: up to 10 minutes with concentration or until strong wind disperses it
createdObjects.notes: Cloudkill creates a yellow-green Heavily Obscured fog Sphere that drifts 10 feet away from the caster at the start of each caster turn and ends early if strong wind disperses it.

cloudkill.description: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered on a point within range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured . Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn. The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.
cloudkill.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

color-spray.name: Color Spray

effects.description: Creatures in the 15-foot Cone must succeed on a Constitution save or gain the Blinded condition until the end of the caster's next turn.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose the 15-foot cone direction; each creature in that cone makes the Constitution save or becomes Blinded until the end of the caster's next turn.

color-spray.description: You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

command.name: Command

effects.description: One visible creature within 60 feet that fails a Wisdom save follows the chosen one-word command on its next turn only: Approach moves by the shortest direct route toward you and ends if within 5 feet, Drop releases held items and ends its turn, Flee moves away by the fastest available means, Grovel becomes Prone and ends its turn, or Halt does not move and takes no action or Bonus Action. Higher-level slots add one target per slot level above 1.

controlOptions.name: Approach
controlOptions.effect: approach
controlOptions.details: Target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

controlOptions.name: Drop
controlOptions.effect: drop
controlOptions.details: Target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

controlOptions.name: Flee
controlOptions.effect: flee
controlOptions.details: Target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

controlOptions.name: Halt
controlOptions.effect: halt
controlOptions.details: On its turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

communicationDetails.commandTiming: target follows the command on its next turn after failed Wisdom save
communicationDetails.notes: Command is a control effect delivered through a spoken one-word instruction.

aiContext.prompt: Choose one command option before casting: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, or Halt.

command.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options: Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn. Halt. On its turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.
command.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

commune.name: Commune

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs incense; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

effects.description: Allows the caster to ask a deity or divine proxy up to three yes-or-no questions during the spell and receive truthful answers, with unclear answers possible when divine knowledge is limited.

knowledgeEffect.notes: Commune answers up to three yes-or-no questions truthfully, but unclear is allowed when the information lies beyond the divine source knowledge.

commune.description: You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

commune-with-nature.name: Commune with Nature

requirements.description: Commune with Nature fails underground; the caster must be able to reach the natural world.
The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

forms.label: Outdoor Knowledge Area
forms.notes: Knowledge area in outdoor natural terrain.

forms.label: Underground Knowledge Area
forms.notes: Reduced radius in caves and other natural underground settings.

effects.description: Commune with nature spirits to learn three chosen facts about the surrounding natural area: within 3 miles outdoors or 300 feet in caves and natural underground settings, but not where construction such as castles or settlements has replaced nature; facts can include settlements, planar portals, one DM-chosen CR 10+ Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead, prevalent plants/minerals/Beasts, or bodies of water.

controlOptions.details: Learn about settlements or constructed features where they are relevant to the natural area and do not make the spell fail.

aiContext.prompt: Choose exactly three facts to learn from the available Commune with Nature categories, and confirm whether the casting area uses the outdoor 3-mile radius or the cave/natural-underground 300-foot radius. The spell does not function where construction has replaced nature.

options.summary: Learn information about prevalent plants, minerals, Beasts, or peoples in the spell's natural area.

options.label: Settlements or constructed features

modeChoice.notes: The caster chooses three information categories; the DM answers those categories as they pertain to the spell's natural area.

commune-with-nature.description: You commune with nature spirits and gain knowledge of the surrounding area. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the area within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn't function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in castles and settlements. Choose three of the following facts; you learn those facts as they pertain to the spell's area: For example, you could determine the location of a powerful monster in the area, the locations of bodies of water, and the locations of any towns.

compelled-duel.name: Compelled Duel

effects.description: One visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, it has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than the caster and cannot willingly move more than 30 feet from the caster for up to 1 minute with concentration. The spell ends if the caster attacks another creature, casts a spell on another enemy, an ally damages the target, or the caster ends a turn more than 30 feet away.

breakConditions: You cast a spell on an enemy other than the target
You end your turn more than 30 feet from the target

effects.description: The compelled target has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than the caster while the duel remains active.
The compelled target cannot willingly move to a space more than 30 feet from the caster while the duel remains active.

compelled-duel.description: You try to compel a creature into a duel. One creature that you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and it can't willingly move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends if you make an attack roll against a creature other than the target, if you cast a spell on an enemy other than the target, if an ally of yours damages the target, or if you end your turn more than 30 feet away from the target.

comprehend-languages.name: Comprehend Languages

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs a pinch of soot and salt; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

components.materialDescription: a pinch of soot and salt

effects.description: Understand spoken, signed, and written language you touch for the duration; reading roughly one page per minute; does not decode symbols or secret messages.

surfaceInteraction.notes: Written-language understanding requires the caster to touch the surface on which the words are written.

visionLightSound.audibleInput: literal meaning of any language caster hears
visionLightSound.visualSignedInput: literal meaning of any signed language caster sees
visionLightSound.visualWrittenInput: literal meaning of written language caster sees while touching surface
visionLightSound.touchRequirement: written words require touching the writing surface

understands: written language seen while touching surface
communicationDetails.notes: The spell provides literal understanding, not codebreaking.

comprehend-languages.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language that you hear or see signed. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn't decode symbols or secret messages.

compulsion.name: Compulsion

effects.description: Each chosen visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed for up to 1 minute with concentration; while Charmed, the caster can use a Bonus Action to choose a horizontal direction, the target must use as much movement as possible on its next turn to move that way by the safest route, and after moving it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

For the duration, the caster can use a Bonus Action to designate a horizontal direction. Each Charmed target must use as much movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn, taking the safest route.

aiContext.prompt: Choose any number of visible creatures within 30 feet, then designate the horizontal direction Charmed targets must move when you use the spell's Bonus Action control.

compulsion.description: Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the spell ends. For the duration, you can take a Bonus Action to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each Charmed target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn, taking the safest route. After moving in this way, a target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

cone-of-cold.name: Cone of Cold

components.materialDescription: a small crystal or glass cone

effects.description: Each creature in a self-originating 60-foot Cone makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success; a creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws, and each slot level above 5 adds +1d8 damage.

createdObjects.name: Frozen Statue Corpse
createdObjects.notes: Cone of Cold is otherwise instantaneous damage, but a creature killed by it becomes a frozen statue until thawed.

cone-of-cold.description: You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.
cone-of-cold.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

confusion.name: Confusion

recurringMechanics.notes: At the start of each affected target turn, roll 1d10 on the spell's behavior table to determine that target's behavior for the turn.

effects.description: Each creature in the 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 90 feet makes a Wisdom save or becomes Confused for up to 1 minute with concentration. While Confused, the target cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions, rolls 1d10 at the start of each turn to determine that turn behavior from the spell table, and repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn to end the spell on itself; each slot level above 4 adds 5 feet to the Sphere radius.

confusion.description: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or that target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and must roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn, consulting the table below. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
confusion.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Sphere's radius increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 4.

conjure-animals.name: Conjure Animals

forms.label: Spectral Pack Threat Radius
forms.notes: Centered on the conjured pack, not on the caster; the pack can move up to 30 feet when you move.

placementEligibility.notes: Conjure Animals places the Large spectral pack in an unoccupied space the caster can see within range; later pack movement also requires a visible unoccupied space.

summon.objectDescription: Large spectral pack of fey animal spirits that can move up to 30 feet when the caster moves and threatens creatures within 10 feet with a Dexterity-save Slashing damage trigger.

savingThrowModifier.notes: The caster has Advantage on Strength saving throws while within 5 feet of the spectral pack.

recurringMechanics.notes: Whenever the pack moves within 10 feet of a visible creature, or a visible creature enters or ends its turn within 10 feet of the pack, the caster can force one Dexterity save per creature per turn. Failure deals Slashing damage; success takes half damage.

effects.description: Creates the summoned creature group as a persistent combat effect; form selection, creature count, and detailed command behavior are deferred to separate summoning work.

placementEligibility.notes: When the caster moves, the pack can also move up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the caster can see.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to place the spectral pack and choose its animal form; while within 5 feet of the pack the caster has Advantage on Strength saves, and when the pack threatens visible creatures within 10 feet prompt the once-per-turn Dexterity save for Slashing damage.

conjure-animals.description: You conjure nature spirits that appear as a Large pack of spectral, intangible animals in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The pack lasts for the duration, and you choose the spirits' animal form, such as wolves, serpents, or birds. You have Advantage on Strength saving throws while you're within 5 feet of the pack, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the pack up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Whenever the pack moves within 10 feet of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters a space within 10 feet of the pack or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d10 Slashing damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
conjure-animals.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 3.

conjure-barrage.name: Conjure Barrage

components.materialDescription: a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP

effects.description: Each chosen creature the caster can see in the self-originating 60-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success; each slot level above 3 adds +1d8 damage.

conjure-barrage.description: You brandish the weapon used to cast the spell and conjure similar spectral weapons (or ammunition appropriate to the weapon) that launch forward and then disappear. Each creature of your choice that you can see in a 60-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
conjure-barrage.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3.

conjure-celestial.name: Conjure Celestial

effects.description: Searing Light: the chosen target makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

conditionalEndings.description: The Bright Light cylinder and its movement option last only until the spell ends.

effects.description: Healing Light: the chosen target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus the caster's spellcasting ability modifier.

conditionalEndings.description: The Bright Light cylinder and its movement option last only until the spell ends.

effects.description: When the caster moves on their turn, the caster can also move the bright Cylinder up to 30 feet.

conditionalEndings.description: The Bright Light cylinder and its movement option last only until the spell ends.

effects.description: A spirit from the Upper Planes manifests as a bright 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder. The caster chooses Healing Light or Searing Light for each visible creature affected, and each creature can be affected only once per turn.

controlOptions.name: Healing Light
controlOptions.effect: The chosen target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus the caster's spellcasting ability modifier.

controlOptions.name: Searing Light
controlOptions.effect: The chosen target makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

controlOptions.name: Bright Light Cylinder
controlOptions.effect: Bright Light fills the Cylinder until the spell ends.

controlOptions.name: Move Cylinder
controlOptions.effect: When the caster moves on their turn, the caster can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet.

controlOptions.name: Once Per Turn
controlOptions.effect: A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.

conditionalEndings.description: The Bright Light cylinder and its movement option last only until the spell ends.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster where the 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high light cylinder appears, whether each visible affected creature receives Healing Light or Searing Light, and where the cylinder moves up to 30 feet when the caster moves.

options.label: Healing Light
options.summary: The chosen target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus the caster's spellcasting ability modifier.

options.label: Searing Light
options.summary: The chosen target makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

modeChoice.notes: Each visible creature affected by the cylinder gets its own light choice, but no creature can be affected more than once per turn.

conjure-celestial.description: You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, which manifests as a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of these lights shines on it: Healing Light. The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Searing Light. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, Bright Light fills the Cylinder, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet. Whenever the Cylinder moves into the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, you can bathe it in one of the lights. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.
conjure-celestial.higherLevels: The healing and damage increase by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 7.

conjure-elemental.name: Conjure Elemental

placementEligibility.notes: The Large elemental spirit appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

recurringMechanics.notes: A target Restrained by the spirit repeats the Dexterity save at the start of each of its turns; failure deals 4d8 damage of the spirit's type and success ends that target's Restrained state.

effects.description: A creature forced to save against the elemental spirit makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 damage of the chosen element on a failed save or no damage on a success; each slot level above 5th adds 1d8 to this initial damage.

controlledEntity.mechanicalRole: one-time elemental spirit damage at chosen point
controlledEntity.control: caster chooses element and point; no persistent creature remains in this data model
controlledEntity.notes: This row is represented as a conjured elemental spirit effect rather than a controllable summoned stat block.

aiContext.prompt: Choose the elemental spirit's element when casting: Air for Lightning damage, Earth for Thunder damage, Fire for Fire damage, or Water for Cold damage. If the spirit has no creature Restrained, force the Dexterity save when a visible creature enters its space or starts within 5 feet.

options.label: Air
options.summary: The elemental spirit deals Lightning damage.

options.label: Earth

options.label: Fire

options.label: Water

modeChoice.notes: The selected element resolves the variable damage type for both the initial 8d8 damage and the recurring 4d8 start-turn damage.

conjure-elemental.description: You conjure a Large, intangible spirit from the Elemental Planes that appears in an unoccupied space within range. Choose the spirit's element, which determines its damage type: air (Lightning), earth (Thunder), fire (Fire), or water (Cold). The spirit lasts for the duration. Whenever a creature you can see enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature Restrained. On failed save, the target takes 8d8 damage of the spirit's type, and the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target repeats the save. On a failed save, the target takes 4d8 damage of the spirit's type. On a successful save, the target isn't Restrained by the spirit.
conjure-elemental.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

conjure-fey.name: Conjure Fey

placementEligibility.notes: The Medium Fey spirit appears in an unoccupied visible space within 60 feet.

formOptions: Fey creature appearance chosen by the caster
summon.objectDescription: Medium Feywild spirit that serves as the origin for the caster's repeatable teleport-and-melee-spell-attack loop.

specialActions.name: Fey Spirit Attack
specialActions.description: The caster makes one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the spirit.

effects.description: Summon one Medium Feywild spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 10 minutes with concentration; it looks like a Fey creature you choose and serves as the origin for the spell attack and later teleport loop.

When the spirit appears, and on later turns after you teleport it with a Bonus Action, you can make one melee spell attack from the spirit against a creature within 5 feet of it; on a hit, the target takes 3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier Psychic damage, increasing by 1d12 per slot level above 6.
A target hit by the Fey spirit attack has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn, with both you and the spirit as the source of the fear.
On later turns, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport the Fey spirit to a visible unoccupied space within 30 feet of the space it left before making the spirit attack.

teleportDestinationEligibility.notes: Later bonus-action teleports move the Fey spirit to an unoccupied visible space within 30 feet of the space it left.

effects.description: Conjure Fey is a repeatable teleport-attack loop: summon the Medium spirit, attack when it appears, then on later turns use a Bonus Action to teleport it up to 30 feet and make the same melee spell attack; a hit deals Psychic damage and Frightens the target until the start of your next turn.

grantedActions.notes: On later turns, the caster can teleport the spirit to an unoccupied visible space within 30 feet of the space it left and make the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

conjure-fey.description: You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirit lasts for the duration, and it looks like a Fey creature of your choice. When the spirit appears, you can make one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes Psychic damage equal to 3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn, with both you and the spirit as the source of the fear. As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can teleport the spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of the space it left and make the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
conjure-fey.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 6.

In addition, the ground in the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.
conjure-minor-elementals.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

conjure-volley.name: Conjure Volley

components.materialDescription: one piece of ammunition or one thrown weapon

Conjures a volley of duplicate ammunition or thrown weapons from the caster's chosen weapon source, defining the damage type used by the existing area damage effect.

Hundreds of duplicates of the ammunition or weapon fall in a volley from above and then disappear. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius. 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is the same as that of the ammunition or weapon.

conjure-woodland-beings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings

effects.description: For up to 10 minutes with concentration, nature spirits flit in a 10-foot Emanation around the caster; when the Emanation enters a visible creature's space, or a visible creature enters it or ends its turn there, that creature can be forced to make a Wisdom save once per turn, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success, with +1d8 per slot level above 4.

conjure-woodland-beings.description: You conjure nature spirits that flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature makes this save only once per turn. conjure-woodland-beings.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

contact-other-plane.name: Contact Other Plane

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

backlash.description: The alien mind on the far end of the contact tears free: DC 15 Intelligence save or take 6d6 psychic damage and go insane until the caster finishes a long rest.

effects.description: When casting the spell, the caster makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. On a failed save, the caster takes 6d6 Psychic damage.
On a failed DC 15 Intelligence save, the caster is Incapacitated until finishing a Long Rest, or until Greater Restoration ends the condition.

On a successful DC 15 Intelligence save, the caster can ask the contacted otherworldly entity up to five questions before the spell ends, and the DM answers each with one word or a short phrase if one word would mislead.

grantedActions.notes: Available only after the caster succeeds on the DC 15 Intelligence save.

knowledgeEffect.notes: On a successful DC 15 Intelligence save, the caster asks up to five questions of a knowledgeable planar entity and receives short one-word-style answers.

aiContext.prompt: On cast, resolve the caster's DC 15 Intelligence save. On success, allow up to five questions before the spell ends; on failure, apply 6d6 Psychic damage and Incapacitated until Long Rest or Greater Restoration.

contact-other-plane.description: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other knowledgeable entity from another plane. Contacting this otherworldly intelligence can break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each question with one word, such as "yes," "no," "maybe," "never," "irrelevant," or "unclear" (if the entity doesn't know the answer to the question). If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might instead offer a short phrase as an answer. On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Incapacitated condition until you finish a Long Rest. A Greater Restoration spell cast on you ends this effect.

contagion.name: Contagion

effects.description: A creature you touch makes a Constitution save; on a failure, it takes 11d8 Necrotic damage and gains the Poisoned condition from the magical contagion.

On a failed Constitution save, the target is Poisoned and repeats the save at the end of each turn until it reaches three successes or three failures. Three successes end the spell on that target; three failures make the Poisoned condition last for 7 days, and attempts to end that Poisoned condition require another Constitution save.

conditionalEndings.description: Three successful repeated Constitution saves end the spell on the target.
Three failed repeated Constitution saves lock the Poisoned duration to 7 days.

effects.description: Choose one ability when you cast Contagion; while Poisoned by this spell, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with that chosen ability.

conditionalEndings.description: Three successful repeated Constitution saves end the spell on the target.
Three failed repeated Constitution saves lock the Poisoned duration to 7 days.

aiContext.prompt: Choose one ability when casting Contagion. While the target is Poisoned by this spell, it has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

options.summary: Poisoned target has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

contagion.description: Your touch inflicts a magical contagion. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability. The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on the target. If the target fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it. Whenever the Poisoned target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the Poisoned condition doesn't end on it.

contingency.name: Contingency

components.materialDescription: a gem-encrusted statuette of yourself worth 1,500+ GP

effects.description: Stores a self-targeting spell of 5th level or lower to trigger automatically when the caster-defined condition occurs, then ends once the contingent spell fires or the contingency is replaced.

aiContext.prompt: Choose the contingent spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, has a casting time of an action, and can target you. Describe the trigger condition exactly; the contingent spell takes effect only on you when that trigger first occurs.

contingency.description: Choose a spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of an action, and that can target you. You cast that spell-called the contingent spell-as part of casting Contingency , expending spell slots for both, but the contingent spell doesn't come into effect. Instead, it takes effect when a certain trigger occurs. You describe that trigger when you cast the two spells. For example, a Contingency cast with Water Breathing might stipulate that Water Breathing comes into effect when you are engulfed in water or a similar liquid. The contingent spell takes effect immediately after the trigger occurs for the first time, whether or not you want it to, and then Contingency ends. The contingent spell takes effect only on you, even if it can normally target others. You can use only one Contingency spell at a time. If you cast this spell again, the effect of another Contingency spell on you ends. Also, Contingency ends on you if its material component is ever not on your person.

continual-flame.name: Continual Flame

continual-flame.description: A flame springs from an object that you touch. The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel. The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

effects.description: Control water in a 100-foot cube within 300 feet for up to 10 minutes with concentration, choosing one active mode at a time: Flood, Part Water, Redirect Flow, or Whirlpool; later Magic actions can repeat or switch modes, and those modes carry the wave, trench, flow, pull, damage, escape, and vehicle-handling rules.

grantedActions.action: Repeat or Change Control Water Effect
grantedActions.notes: On later turns, the caster can repeat the same water-control effect or choose a different Control Water mode.

In a large body of water it creates a 20-foot-tall wave that travels across the area, carries Huge-or-smaller vehicles, gives struck Huge-or-smaller vehicles a 25 percent capsize chance, and repeats at the start of the caster's next turn while Flood remains active.

createdObjects.name: Parted Water Trench
createdObjects.shelfLife: 10 minutes concentration or until another Control Water option is chosen

createdObjects.name: Control Water Whirlpool

createdObjects.notes: Whirlpool requires water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. It forms in the center of the area, is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Creatures in water within 25 feet are pulled 10 feet toward it; entering or ending a turn there calls for a Strength save against 2d8 Bludgeoning damage, and swimming away requires an action plus a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell save DC.

conditionalEndings.description: The current Flood, Part Water, Redirect Flow, or Whirlpool mode ends/replaces when the caster chooses a different effect.
The active water-control mode ends when the spell ends.

aiContext.prompt: Choose Flood, Part Water, Redirect Flow, or Whirlpool for the controlled water; later Magic actions can repeat the current effect or choose a different one.

control-water.description: Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one. Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing. The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts. Part Water. You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored. Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell's area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. Whirlpool. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.

When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 x 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal. When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.

control-winds.description: You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube that you can see within range. Choose one of the following effects when you cast the spell. The effect lasts for the spell's duration, unless you use your action on a later turn to switch to a different effect. You can also use your action to temporarily halt the effect or to restart one you've halted. Gusts. A wind picks up within the cube, continually blowing in a horizontal direction you designate. You choose the intensity of the wind: calm, moderate, or strong. If the wind is moderate or strong, ranged weapon attacks that enter or leave the cube or pass through it have disadvantage on their attack rolls. If the wind is strong, any creature moving against the wind must spend 1 extra foot of movement for each foot moved. Downdraft. You cause a sustained blast of strong wind to blow downward from the top of the cube. Ranged weapon attacks that pass through the cube or that are made against targets within it have disadvantage on their attack rolls. A creature must make a Strength saving throw if it flies into the cube for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there flying. On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone. Updraft. You cause a sustained updraft within the cube, rising upward from the cube's bottom side. Creatures that end a fall within the cube take only half damage from the fall. When a creature in the cube makes a vertical jump, the creature can jump up to 10 feet higher than normal.
